title: COMP Layout Page
summary: Official Derivative common Layout page for Panel COMP position, size, aspect, depth layer, fixed/fill/anchor sizing, parent alignment, align order, post offset, and size-from-window behavior.
guidance: Use this article when panel size and position need to survive parent resizing.
Depth Layer controls draw order among sibling panel components; higher values draw over lower values, and equal layers fall back to operator name ordering.
Use Fill for parent-size matching and normalized anchors plus pixel offsets for stretchy proportional layouts.
Parent Alignment can allow parent alignment, ignore it while respecting margins, or ignore both alignment and margins.
Size from Window lets the floating viewer window set panel width and height.
